name: Daemonic Allegiance
community_notes: [APPROX] the choice is made once, when the model is added to the army, and also equips the matching god-specific ranged weapon (torrent of burning blood / warp gaze / phlegm bombardment / scream of despair)

name: HORRORS ARE PINK. HORRORS ARE BLUE. WHERE ONCE THERE WAS ONE, NOW THERE ARE TWO.
community_notes: [APPROX] while any PINK HORROR models remain, the Blue Horrors datasheet's Sullen Malevolence and Exploding Horrors abilities do not apply

name: Shadow Form Abilities
community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of each battle round Belakor picks one Shadow Form ability (a re-selectable start-of-battle-round choice). The specific Shadow Form options are defined on the datasheet and are not enumerated in the rule prose, so this is captured as an opaque ability grant rather than a stance-select menu. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Warp Rifts
community_notes: [APPROX] Grants the reduced Deep Strike distance (set up more than 6" from enemies instead of 9") as an opaque ability grant. The placement preconditions — set up wholly within the army's Shadow of Chaos, and/or wholly within 6" of a friendly Bloodthirster/Great Unclean One/Kairos Fateweaver/Keeper of Secrets/Lord of Change/Rotigus/Shalaxi Helbane/Skarbrand unit sharing its god keyword — are not gated in the DSL. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Fates In Flux
community_notes: [APPROX] Modeled with the pooled-resource `replace-roll-from-pool` frame over a `flux-token-pool`, covering the rolls a Flux token affects for your LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH units. Semantically a Flux token funds a re-roll (not a die-value substitution), and the token economy — starting with three tokens, the opponent gaining a token whenever you spend one, the reciprocal opponent re-roll, and the Command-phase regain — is not modeled. Pool state is not tracked by the buff layer (fail-safe). Full rule in raw-text store.
